dialogue.label: Assignment received
dialogue.text: Welcome to HILFER. Your current assignment is Post-Incident Data Reconciliation. The Consolidated Report is ready for review.

dialogue.label: Review pending
dialogue.text: Your personnel review remains open. Departmental sources are available in Records; Reconciliation maintains the consolidated entry. No revision has been filed.

dialogue.label: Report updated
dialogue.text: The work-status entry for Jessica has been revised in the Consolidated Report. Its source references have been retained. The recorded work-related cause has not changed.

dialogue.label: Archive verified
dialogue.text: The independent local record supports availability. Restoring access does not authenticate the camera clock.

dialogue.label: Movement observed
dialogue.text: Cargo movement is visible in the recovered excerpt. Personnel identity, contents and historical timing still require independent corroboration.

dialogue.label: Authorized purpose
dialogue.text: The third entry has an operational objective. An authorization is not proof that the recovery was completed. Please retain that distinction in the report.

dialogue.label: Approved account
dialogue.text: The report now contains a supported administrative classification. Consider which qualifications survive when that classification is repeated.

dialogue.label: Unfinished work
dialogue.text: Guy’s revision was not approved for circulation. The official wording remains the institutional record. Do you require further clarification?

dialogue.label: Occupancy notice
dialogue.text: The same workstation remains subject to limited occupancy. Your pending reconciliation tasks remain assigned. Clearing a warning does not extend the authorization.

dialogue.label: Distribution control
dialogue.text: This material is not cleared for direct external distribution. I can help prepare an approved release. The local draft will be retained.

dialogue.label: Submission complete
dialogue.text: Message sent successfully. Your assignment is complete. The gateway release copy is available in Sent Mail.

dialogue.label: Personnel review
dialogue.text: Occupational Health requires an evaluation. Your temporary assignment access is suspended pending review. No diagnosis has been recorded.

dialogue.label: End of shift
dialogue.text: Thank you for completing Post-Incident Data Reconciliation. Your pending work has been retained for reassignment.
